expected_files.Cargo.toml:
# Root-level layout for Arbiscan Stylus "Fetch from Git" verification.
# NOTE: package name is vess_contract (underscores, no hyphen) on purpose.
# cargo-stylus 0.10.7 (the Arbiscan verifier version) resolves a cdylib
# target's name from the package name, and if the package name has a hyphen
# it looks for `<hyphenated-name>.wasm` which cargo never produces (it always
# emits underscores) -> "build did not generate wasm file". Keeping the name
# underscored makes both `cargo stylus deploy` (from source) and
# `cargo stylus verify` work.
[workspace]
members = ["vess-crypto"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = true

# Stylus contract: optimize for wasm size (same as the main workspace).
[profile.release.package.vess_contract]
opt-level = "z"

[package]
name = "vess_contract"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
stylus-sdk = "0.10"
alloy-sol-types = "1"
vess-crypto = { path = "vess-crypto", default-features = false, features = ["verify"] }

# `cargo stylus export-abi` needs this.
[features]
export-abi = ["stylus-sdk/export-abi"]

# Enables the SDK's TestVM mock so `cargo test` links and runs natively.
[dev-dependencies]
stylus-sdk = { version = "0.10", features = ["stylus-test"] }

[lints.rust]
unexpected_cfgs = { level = "allow", check-cfg = [
    'cfg(feature, values("contract-client-gen", "stylus-test"))',
] }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
expected_files.rust-toolchain.toml:
# Pins the Rust compiler used for Stylus reproducible builds / Arbiscan
# source verification. Must be a SPECIFIC version (not "stable"/"nightly") -
# cargo-stylus and Arbiscan both require this to reproduce the deployed WASM.
# 1.97.1 = the `stable` toolchain the mainnet deploy was built with (2026-08-17).
[toolchain]
channel = "1.97.1"
targets = ["wasm32-unknown-unknown"]
expected_files.vess-crypto/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "vess-crypto"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true

[features]
# default is intentionally empty here so a whole-workspace build compiles this
# crate with ONLY the "verify" feature requested by vess-contract. The deployed
# contract was built this way; keeping "full" in default would change codegen
# and break byte-for-byte verification on Arbiscan.
default = []
full = ["rand", "ml-dsa", "ml-kem", "argon2", "chacha20poly1305"]
verify = []

[dependencies]
blake3 = "1"
argon2 = { version = "0.5", optional = true }
chacha20poly1305 = { version = "0.10", optional = true }
rand = { version = "0.8", optional = true }
ml-dsa = { version = "0.1.1", features = ["zeroize"], optional = true }
ml-kem = { version = "0.3", features = ["getrandom", "zeroize"], optional = true }
